subject: general
question: Which one of the following is the correct sequence of steps in Digestive System?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ingestion, Digestion, Absorption, Egestion.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The digestive system includes 5 steps, They are in order as follows::
 
 
• Ingestion
 
• Digestion
 
• Absorption
 
• Assimilation
 
• Egestion
 
 
 
• Ingestion: It is the process of taking food into the body by the animal.
 
• Digestion: It is the process in which food containing larger molecules is converted or break down into small water-soluble molecules.
 
• Absorption: It is the process in which digested food goes into the bloodstream.
 
• Assimilation: It is the process in which absorbed food is taken up by the body cells for their growth and energy.
 
• Egestion: It is the process in which undigested is discharged as faeces.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Human digestive system-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b905d7003d06f4639a74ccbd24f9cf2bdcff2761f7ec676a8d5b9d6de2e57d19.png] 

 
• The size of an adult's digestion pipe in a human body is 30 feet.
 
• The small intestine is the longest part of the digestive system.
 
• Water and mineral are absorbed by the large intestine.
 
• Digestion of cellulose is absent in the human body.
 
• The appendix is a vestigial organ in the human body.
